description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages a UI with a fragment, a log display, and menu options for toggling log visibility. It initializes logging components and handles user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages UI components, logging, and menu interactions for a drag-and-drop sample app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the DragSourceFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling log visibility and updating the menu item title.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling the log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
